fix.shows: The appeal records for West Bengal, collected by the Civic Research Group and checked by The Wire, show the Commission appealed against 16,08,175 of the 32,53,401 voters the judicial officers had cleared, or 49.4%. In an earlier extract of 13,95,794 appeal IDs, 99.3% carry a timestamp of 5, 6 or 8 April, and more than 12 lakh carry 5 April. The Commission told the Supreme Court in September that it had filed 16,10,311 appeals against inclusion.
